title: Impact of Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIRS) in ICUs
official: Impact of Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIRS) on the Diffusion of ESBL Producing Enterobacterales in Intensive Care Units (ICU)
summary: This study will assess the impact of FTIRS typing on the spread of ESBL-E in intensive care units
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients hospitalized in ICU
* ESBL-E carrier

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
